entities.summary: Berber, a notable figure in the history of Algeria, associated with Islamic Conquest and Medieval Dynasties (1235–1556). Preceded by Zayyanid Kingdom of Tlemcen and Hilalian. Their legacy influenced Barbarossa Brothers and Corsairs.
